content.title: Debunking Denver Airport Conspiracy Theories | Be MediaWise | PBS LearningMedia
content.text: Lateral Reading: Students learn how to use lateral reading and the Stanford History Education Group’s “Three Questions” - Who is behind the information? What is the evidence? What do other sources say? - to decode a conspiracy theory about the Denver airport. About the Next Video:Zeroing in on the “zombie” virus claim: Students practice “reading upstream” to find a primary, credible source and learn what a “zombie claim” is as they investigate a post about melting glaciers releasing long-dormant viruses.
